answer: Score an identity by who pays it, not by how many keys it holds. Each epoch the ledger builds a flow graph of settled payments and min-cuts every candidate cluster. Transfers looping inside one operator's own accounts score zero, since value returning to its origin proves nothing; only payment from independent counterparties counts, weighted by how spread they are. Ten thousand puppets settle in a closed circuit, onyx ledger flat while the power bill is not. To climb it must sell something real to strangers. No fable covers that gap: standing is one distinct client per unit, clear as crystal.
